description: This file defines a `Rect` class with properties and methods for rectangle geometry operations, including containment, intersection, and creation from points or DOM elements. It also exports a `ContainsPointReturn` type for detailed containment check results, and imports utility functions and types from a 'point' module.

classes.name: Rect
classes.description: A class representing a rectangle with methods for geometric calculations such as containment, intersection, and creation from various inputs.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Overloaded method to check if a point or rectangle is contained within this rectangle. If a point, returns detailed result with reasons; if a rectangle, returns boolean.
